TestCounters::test_prepare_unset_value.description: Single node, protocol v4. Sets counter t=0 to 1, then executes prepared 'c = c + ?' with UNSET_VALUE for 1000 keys (incl. t=0). Asserts table still has exactly one row [0, 1], i.e. unset counter increment is a no-op and creates no rows.
